description_for_human: Resolve global companies (UK CRN, Swiss UID, Australian ABN, Singapore UEN, US SEC CIK, EU registries, LEI), validate EU VAT via VIES, and screen OFAC/EU/UN sanctions.
description_for_model: Use this plugin whenever you need to verify a company registration number, look up an LEI or US SEC CIK, validate a European Union VAT number via VIES, or screen a company/individual against OFAC SDN, EU Financial Sanctions, and UN Security Council lists.
